smarttrade.list.title: CONFIGURABLE TRADES
smarttrade.trade.egg.lore: Every egg sold promises new recipes, and attentive farmers know that even the smallest shells can produce a tidy fortune.
smarttrade.trade.egg.description: Allows the farmer to buy 20 eggs for 1 emerald.
smarttrade.trade.cocoa_beans.lore: From distant jungles, cocoa beans perfume the market and remind farmers that rare flavors are worth plenty of emeralds today.
smarttrade.trade.cocoa_beans.description: Allows the farmer to buy 20 cocoa beans for 1 emerald.
smarttrade.trade.honeycomb.lore: Each honeycomb preserves a hive's patient labor, a golden wealth that farmers welcome as the finest treasure of the season.
smarttrade.trade.honeycomb.description: Allows the farmer to buy 10 honeycombs for 1 emerald.
smarttrade.trade.spider_eye.lore: Clerics seek spider eyes for studies few dare question, paying well for every unsettling remnant of hunts in the darkness.
smarttrade.trade.spider_eye.description: Allows the cleric to buy 15 spider eyes for 1 emerald.
smarttrade.trade.ender_pearl.lore: Ender Pearls still whisper of distant places, and clerics collect their echoes to understand hidden pathways through the void.
smarttrade.trade.ender_pearl.description: Allows the cleric to buy 3 Ender pearls for 1 emerald.
smarttrade.trade.redstone.lore: Redstone glows like living thought; clerics gather its dust for mysteries where devotion and clever machinery walk together.
smarttrade.trade.redstone.description: Allows the cleric to buy 20 redstone dust for 1 emerald.
smarttrade.trade.lapis_lazuli.lore: Blue as a cloudless sky, lapis carries an affinity for enchantment and always finds a place upon the altars of village clerics.
smarttrade.trade.lapis_lazuli.descriptio: Allows the cleric to buy 20 lapis lazuli for 1 emerald.
smarttrade.trade.bone.lore: Butchers use what others abandon; even dry bones find a purpose when skilled hands refuse to let useful materials go to waste.
smarttrade.trade.bone.description: Allows the butcher to buy 20 bones for 1 emerald.
smarttrade.trade.arrow.lore: Fletchers recognize balance and precision at a glance, buying fine arrows so the village defenses are never caught unprepared.
smarttrade.trade.arrow.description: Allows the fletcher to buy 15 arrows for 1 emerald.
smarttrade.options.title: GLOBAL OPTIONS
smarttrade.options.subtitle: Select the global options you want to enable.
smarttrade.options.jade_reputation.lore: Villagers reveal more than words; attentive eyes perceive trust, daily routines, and old debts engraved upon every expression.
smarttrade.options.jade_reputation.descr: Shows three values for the observed villager in Jade: reputation toward the player, green with a + sign above 0, red below 0, and gray at 0; restocks completed that day in current/2 format; and Cured as Yes when that player's major_positive reputation is above 0. With MAXIMUM REPUTATION, reputation shows +150 while Cured uses the real data. Requires Jade.
smarttrade.options.maximum_reputation.lo: Your name crosses the village before your footsteps; doors open, prices yield, and every villager welcomes a trusted old friend.
smarttrade.options.maximum_reputation.de: Makes every reputation query from any villager return 150 for the player, affecting special prices for vanilla and SMART TRADE offers. For the mod's nine offers, the 0.05 multiplier reduces the cost by 7 items before demand and other modifiers, respecting the final minimum price of 1 item. Vanilla offers use their own multipliers. Real reputation data remains preserved.
smarttrade.options.soul_speed_nether.lor: Restless souls grant their momentum only where the Nether feeds their power; far away, the ground stays quiet under every step.
smarttrade.options.soul_speed_nether.des: Restricts Soul Speed's effects to the Nether. In other dimensions, living entities with any enchantment level receive a 1.0 speed factor on blocks in the minecraft:soul_speed_blocks tag. Ridden horses also receive this factor when their controlling passenger wears the enchantment. The check considers the block at the entity's position and the block below. In vanilla content, the tag contains exactly soul sand and soul soil; data packs and mods can expand it.
smarttrade.options.fixed_mushroom_height: Even bone meal magic honors ancient proportions, guiding fungi and trees toward heights worthy of a great harmonious forest.

Standardizes bone-meal growth: red and brown mushrooms on crimson or warped nylium use 5- and 4-block stems and occupy up to 6 and 5 layers with the cap; jungle and acacia saplings use a 6-block trunk; crimson and warped fungi on their matching nylium use a 6-block stem in 11 of 12 cases or 12 blocks in 1 of 12, occupying up to 7 or 13 layers. Preserves the 40% chance for mushrooms and fungi and 45% for saplings, applying height only when the tree is generated, plus vanilla support, space, height, and replacement requirements.
smarttrade.options.compact_horse_health_: Experienced riders read a mount's strength without counting every heart; one clear row reveals everything they need to know.

Limits the health HUD for horses, donkeys, mules, zombie horses, and skeleton horses to one row of 10 hearts, filled proportionally to the mount's maximum health. Changes only the display; actual health, damage, and healing remain unchanged.
smarttrade.options.equestrian_hud.lore: Upon the saddle, rider and mount share one destiny; their signs remain together in view throughout every demanding journey.
smarttrade.options.equestrian_hud.descri: Shows the player's food and the mount's health at the same time, also repositioning air bubbles to prevent overlaps. Keeps the experience bar and level visible while the mount is not jumping; holding the jump key or starting to charge displays the jump bar. (GPL)
smarttrade.options.automatic_door_closin: Well-kept homes leave no entrance open to danger; doors and gates remember to close after the passing traveler moves onward.

Closes wooden doors and fence gates 5 seconds (100 ticks) after the player opens them directly in a singleplayer world. Before closing, checks whether the position still contains the same type of open block; if it is closed, absent, or has been changed to another block, nothing happens. After closing, checks again in 0.5 seconds and, if the block is still open, makes only one extra attempt. Opening it again restarts the countdown.
smarttrade.options.disable_chat_history_: A true Minecrafter masters commands without relying on shortcuts, guided only by memory, hard-earned knowledge, and practice.
Prevents the up and down arrow keys from navigating through previous messages and commands on the chat screen. The history continues to be stored normally.
smarttrade.options.compact_item_counts.l: Every inventory space deserves clarity; small, precise numbers count reserves without concealing the treasures being carried.
smarttrade.options.compact_item_counts.d: Replaces item stack count numbers with a compact 3x5 font inspired by Create's interface, with a dark outline to remain readable over light and dark backgrounds. Changes only the display; the actual item quantities remain unchanged. (GPL)
Good adventurers' packs defy unlikely volumes, arranging provisions and relics so that no worthy journey must end too early.

Changes the maximum stack size of soups, Ender pearls, cakes, and items in the c:eggs tag to 64; saddles, potions, harnesses, boats, beds, enchanted books, music discs, and items in the c:buckets tag to 16. Recognizes the c:foods/soup, c:potions, minecraft:harnesses, minecraft:boats, minecraft:beds, c:music_discs, c:eggs, and c:buckets tags, including items added to them by data packs and mods. Designed for singleplayer worlds; on external servers, the server controls the actual limits.
smarttrade.options.random_suspicious_ste: Every bowl conceals a different fate; bold adventurers taste the broth without knowing which strange surprise they will awaken.

Allows up to 64 Suspicious Stews to stack regardless of their original effect. Each consumed unit has an equal 10% chance to grant one of these vanilla effects and durations: Saturation for 0.35 seconds; Night Vision for 5 seconds; Fire Resistance for 3 seconds; Blindness for 11 seconds; Weakness for 7 seconds; Regeneration for 7 seconds; Jump Boost for 5 seconds; Wither for 7 seconds; Poison for 11 seconds; or Nausea for 7 seconds. Works independently of Impossible Packs and is designed for singleplayer worlds; on external servers, the server controls stacking and effects.
smarttrade.options.random_experience_orb: Different experiences leave different glows; each orb chooses a color to celebrate the story it helped the adventurer create.
Assigns each experience orb a stable color, randomly chosen from #FFBF0B, #FB5607, #FF006E, and #3A86FF, with 180/255 opacity. The color remains the same throughout the orb's existence.
smarttrade.options.compact_information_o: Prepared adventurers know their surroundings at a glance, gathering time, direction, and resources without abandoning the path.

Toggles an uppercase overlay in the top-left corner with one press of TAB, containing the time in 12-hour format, used/maximum memory and percentage, current/limited FPS, integer coordinates of the block occupied by the player, direction with axis, and biome. The memory line is green through 75% and red from 76%. Direct TAB detection is independent of configured controls. Keeps the player list and the vanilla debug screen unchanged.
smarttrade.options.compact_game_menus.lo: Every journey begins with a clear choice; well-ordered paths lead players toward the world without unnecessary distractions.
smarttrade.options.compact_game_menus.de: Organizes the out-of-game and in-game menus with the first button in one 200 px row and the remaining buttons in two 98 px columns separated by 4 px. Out of game: Player; Players and Mods; Friends and Realms; Options and Quit. In game: Play; Friends and Mods; LAN and Statistics; Options and Save (Quit). Removes icons from both menus and the version text in the lower-left corner of the title screen; Language and Accessibility remain in vanilla options, while Advancements, Report, Feedback, and Report bug are placed inside Options during the game.
smarttrade.options.insane_difficulty.lor: When danger abandons all restraint, even seasoned warriors face a world determined to turn every night into a relentless trial.
smarttrade.options.insane_difficulty.des: Adds Insane to Minecraft's difficulty list without selecting it automatically. Removes the world's difficulty lock, hides the padlock, and expands the selector to 150 px. In world selection, replaces the identifier on the second line with each world's difficulty while preserving the date and time. When chosen, it keeps every Hard rule but raises damage taken by the player and equine mounts to 250%, the chance for zombies to spawn with an iron weapon or tool to 30%, raids to 12 waves, and the maximum chance for spiders to spawn with an effect to 30%. Multiplies the natural spawn selection weight of Witches by 12 and Endermen by 6 without changing groups, mob caps, biomes, or other vanilla rules; spawners, structures, commands, and special summons are unaffected. Regular skeletons fire every 0.5 second and always spawn with a Flame-enchanted bow. Burning arrows embedded in blocks retain their fire and effects but are visually rendered as normal arrows. Melee mobs chasing a mounted player attack the horse when they can reach the mount but not the rider. Horses, donkeys, mules, zombie horses, and skeleton horses receive 60 ticks of invulnerableTime after an accepted hit; equal or weaker hits are ignored for the first 50 ticks (2.5 seconds), creating a window for the mount to resume moving and escape after neighing and immobilization.
